mustScenarios.risk: Applying a coupon whose expiresAt is in the past
The same user applies the same coupon a second time
The percentage discount would exceed maxDiscount and is capped
Applying a coupon to a cart that already has a promotion

secondOrder.risk: A percentage coupon with a 0% rate is applied.
A coupon whose capped discount is larger than the cart total is applied to a small cart.
A coupon is applied in the same second as its expiresAt.
A coupon is valid when applied on the checkout page and expires before the customer pays.
A coupon code e-mailed to one customer is entered by a different account.
An order paid with the coupon is refunded and the same user applies the coupon again.
A promotion becomes active on the cart after the coupon was applied.

forbidden.description: Gift cards, loyalty points and fixed-amount coupons appear in neither the PRD scope nor the code

notes: AC3 (expiry check) is not implemented: Coupon.expiresAt exists but is never read.
